title: Eval Suite
description: Configuration schema for Eval evaluation suites (contract v2.0.0).

name.description: Suite name, used in report titles.

timeout_seconds.description: Suite-level timeout budget (seconds) propagated to command checks. Timed-out commands are terminated.

parallel_workers.description: Opt-in parallel worker count for independent file checks. Value 1 keeps serial execution.

setup.description: Shell command to run once before all tests.

teardown.description: Shell command to run once after all tests.

before_each.description: Shell command to run before each test.

after_each.description: Shell command to run after each test.

policy_profile.description: Optional policy preset for enterprise onboarding. Explicit command/path/env policy fields override preset defaults.

path_policy_mode.description: Path policy behavior. allowlist-required enforces explicit allowed_paths for path-backed checks in guarded stages.

path_policy_profile.description: Optional named path-policy preset. Explicit path_policy_mode and allowed_paths fields override preset defaults.

policy_stage_overlays.description: Optional stage-specific policy overlays applied when --policy-stage or KUJO_EVAL_POLICY_STAGE is set.

history_retention_runs.description: Maximum number of run entries retained in history.json.

aux_artifact_retention_files.description: Maximum number of auxiliary backup artifacts (*.bak) retained per output directory.

artifact_checksums.description: When true, artifact-manifest.json includes SHA-256 checksums for generated artifacts.

allowed_command_patterns.description: Optional allowlist of command substrings. A command must match at least one when configured.

command_pattern_match_mode.description: How allowed/blocked command patterns are matched: substring (legacy) or token-aware sequence matching.

require_command_policy.description: When true, CI/release policy stages fail closed for command-backed checks unless an explicit command allowlist policy is configured.

blocked_arg_patterns.description: Optional denylist of command argument substrings that are always rejected.

redaction_audit_mode.description: When true, command check details include redaction audit metadata (redaction_hits, redaction_patterns).

redact_output_patterns.description: Optional additional organization-specific redaction patterns applied to command stdout/stderr.

allowed_paths.description: Optional allowlist of directory paths for file checks.

allowed_http_hosts.description: Optional allowlist of outbound HTTP hostnames (or host:port values) for http_status and http_body_contains checks.

blocked_http_hosts.description: Optional denylist of outbound HTTP hostnames. If a host matches both allow and block lists, blocked_http_hosts takes precedence.

allowed_env_vars.description: Optional allowlist of environment variable names.

check.description: Check type — one of 27 supported assertion types.

params.description: Check-specific parameters. See docs/eval-suite-reference.md for per-check param details.

skip.description: Set true to skip this test.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-test timeout budget (seconds) for command checks. Timed-out commands are terminated.

depends_on.description: Test names this test depends on. If any dependency fails, this test is skipped.
